defect_1_no_op_placebo.definition: A negative control that permutes a GROUPING KEY and then RECOMPUTES the aggregate from the permuted key is a NO-OP: the permuted cell is the same row set under a new name, so every row still receives its own true value.
defect_1_no_op_placebo.diagnostic_signature: reproduces the real number with sd exactly 0.000000
defect_1_no_op_placebo.correct_form: compute the aggregate on the TRUE grouping, then permute which rows receive which already-computed aggregate value
defect_1_no_op_placebo.headline: NO NO-OP PLACEBO FOUND IN ANY SHIPPED E0 SCREEN. The only instance in the program is the one I0010 caught and fixed inside its own script before its verdict was reached. No verdict is downgraded by Defect 1.

evidence.construction: no permutation, placebo, negative-control or RNG construct exists anywhere in this screen. NOTES.md contains no placebo section.

E0_I0003_rebound_interaction.reasoning: The kill rests on a year-over-year stability comparison (fused REB/min r=0.917 vs decomposed 0.275-0.786) and one null interaction proxy, and the coordinator annotation already records that the comparison is CONFOUNDED BY MEASUREMENT NOISE (~72% correct side-of-play). There is no placebo support to remove. The verdict's existing caveats are unchanged and remain the binding limitation.

E0_I0004_shot_location_allowance.sub_form: specificity control, not a permutation null

evidence.construction: correlates the player's shooting_residual against the opponent's POOLED (season, non-zone) FG% allowed. The aggregate is computed on TRUE opponents; a DIFFERENT, deliberately non-informative aggregate is substituted for the zone-specific one. No grouping key is permuted, so the no-op mechanism cannot arise.
evidence.measured_result: corr = +0.0211 on n=121,412 (run_log.txt), against real Restricted-Area diff +0.0392. It does NOT reproduce the real number.

E0_I0004_shot_location_allowance.placebo_sd_note: not measurable: a single statistic, no draws recorded. This control has NO distribution and therefore is NOT a noise floor and must not be read as one.
E0_I0004_shot_location_allowance.reasoning: The iterate rests on three supports the placebo is not one of: (a) Restricted Area is the only zone with real between-team dispersion in opponent allowance, (b) the leave-one-game-out interaction is sign-consistent across both within-partition halves (+0.049 / +0.034), (c) the Corner-3 self-inclusion leak was found and corrected. The placebo is corroborative only. Standing gap, not a downgrade: this screen has no noise floor bounding its +0.0392 effect.

evidence.construction: X1 = player_tendency_loo is an ALREADY-COMPUTED per-row value. The loop permutes its ASSIGNMENT TO ROWS within season (`X1_perm[idx] = rng.permutation(X1_perm[idx])`), then rebuilds the interaction and re-residualises from the permuted assignment. This is the correct form: it breaks the row-to-value pairing, it does not rename a grouping key.

E0_I0005_turnover_interaction.placebo_sd_source: re-run from a COPY at experiments/exploration/AUDIT_SCREEN_INTEGRITY/rerun_I0005_permutation_sd.py with outputs repointed; same seed 20260807, same n_perm 2000. 2000/2000 unique draws. Reproduced the shipped p-value 0.004 exactly. The screen's summary.json does not record the sd, which is why a re-run was required.
E0_I0005_turnover_interaction.reasoning: Doubly safe. First, the permutation is genuine. Second, the kill was made AGAINST the permutation, not on it: p=0.004 was explicitly overruled because per-season partial correlations (0.058 / -0.002 / 0.021 / 0.002) fail replication. A broken placebo could only have made the interaction look better, which is the direction the screen already refused.

E0_I0006_usage_redistribution.sub_form: matched-sample event placebo, not a permutation

evidence.construction: Placebo events are the studied player's OWN PRESENCE games - games where no absence occurred - with leave_one_out=True at line 82 so the pseudo-event game is excluded from the teammate baseline. The identical top1_share statistic is computed on a no-treatment event set. No grouping key is permuted anywhere, so the no-op mechanism structurally cannot arise.
evidence.superseded_first_pass: experiments/exploration/E0_I0006_usage_redistribution/placebo_check.py lines 30-67, same construction, run against the pre-rebuild data

E0_I0006_usage_redistribution.placebo_sd_source: placebo_presence_games.csv: n=167 events, mean 0.5078, sd 0.1724, 166/167 unique values. Real arm clean_per_absence_game_summary.csv: n=578, mean 0.4699, sd 0.1311. Both distributions are richly dispersed; neither is degenerate.
E0_I0006_usage_redistribution.reasoning: THIS WAS THE HIGHEST-STAKES ITEM IN THE AUDIT. I0006 is the ONLY screen whose kill rests ENTIRELY on the placebo - the finding IS 'the placebo (0.539) is more concentrated than the real effect (0.470)'. Had this placebo been a no-op the kill would have been unsupported. It is not a no-op; it is not even a permutation, so the defect's mechanism does not apply. The kill stands.
residual_caveats_not_fatal: matched-n asymmetry: placebo events require >=7 presence games while real events require >=6 control games
n asymmetry: 578 real events vs 200 placebo (167 realised in the retained first-pass artifact)
the screen itself already discloses that a matched blowout/back-to-back placebo would be tighter (NOTES.md:129-131), and notes the direction reversed rather than merely failing to reach significance

evidence.construction: no permutation, placebo, negative-control or RNG construct exists in this screen. The only regex hit was `_neg_clock` at build.py:60-73, which is a descending sort key for a merge_asof join and is unrelated to negative controls.

E0_I0008_height_differential.reasoning: The iterate rests on incremental R2 over the player's own recent rate (+0.018-0.020), a median-split bucket check, stability across all four seasons (r=0.32-0.36), and a position cut. None of that is placebo-derived, so nothing is removed.
E0_I0008_height_differential.standing_gap_flagged_not_a_downgrade: This screen's +0.018-0.020 incremental R2 has never been compared against ANY noise floor. That is an ABSENT support, not a broken one - it does not reverse or downgrade the verdict. But I0006 demonstrated inside this same program that a concentration-style statistic can look like a finding and be beaten by its own noise floor. Recommend a permutation null (permute which opponent's roster-height aggregate each row receives, keeping the aggregate keyed on true opponents) before this lead's placebo strength is weighed against I0009's or I0011's.

evidence.construction: The PregamePressure panel is keyed on TRUE team ids. PMAT precomputes every team's pregame pressure as of every played date. The placebo reassigns a DIFFERENT column per row: `off = rng.integers(1, n_teams_row)` at line 144 starts at 1, never 0, so no row can receive its own opponent. Line 136 asserts `np.allclose(recon, P_PRE)` - the precomputed lookup reproduces the real pregame pressure EXACTLY - which proves construction identity while identity of the opponent is the only thing that varies. This is precisely the correct form.

E0_I0009_additive_pressure.placebo_sd_source: run_log.txt: 'placebo pooled dR2: mean=0.000093 sd=0.000105 median=0.000057 p95=0.000313 max=0.000504'; real pooled dR2 = 0.0065, ~70x the placebo mean; 0/200 draws reach real.
E0_I0009_additive_pressure.reasoning: The coordinator's prior finding (placebo_verified_genuine: YES) is independently reproduced here by direct code inspection, and corroborated by a nonzero recorded spread. No change to the verdict. Its six existing caveats (home/away confound, 2023 clearing by only 1.07x, dR2 as an upper bound, rung-2 hybrid, in-sample WLS, per-season degradation under the quality control) are untouched by this audit and remain the binding limitations.

E0_I0010_positional_matchup.reasoning: The kill was reached with the CORRECTED placebo, and the shipped draws confirm it empirically. Existing caveats stand unchanged and this audit adds no new ones: the pts placebo fraction 0.020 is carried by 2023 alone (per-season 0.49/0.45/0.040/0.28), but the pts kill does not rest on the placebo - it rests on interaction dR2 collapsing to 0.00001 under the overall-defence control. E0_I0011_tendency_estimator.sub_form: single-draw negative controls, not a permutation distribution

evidence.line_numbers: 79-91 (deranged donor map); 160-176 (the three controls); 163-176 is NEG_other_player
evidence.construction: NEG_other_player assigns ANOTHER player's ALREADY-COMPUTED expanding estimate to this player's rows (lut built at 164-166, reassignment at 167-176), with a donor map deranged by `np.roll(shuffled, 1)` at line 87 so nobody maps to self. This is exactly the correct 'permute the assignment of an already-computed value to rows' form. NEG_league_const (161) and NEG_reversed (160) are constructed controls, not permutations.

E0_I0011_tendency_estimator.placebo_sd_note: not applicable by design - a single draw, no distribution. The no-op signature is nonetheless DEFINITIVELY ABSENT, because a no-op would have reproduced the real estimator's MAE. It does not: NEG_other_player degrades MAE by 1.7-2.7x on every target and ranks LAST on all four.
E0_I0011_tendency_estimator.reasoning: The verdict rests on a disjoint select(2021-2022) / score(2023-2024) MAE gap against the incumbent, not on the negative controls. The controls are a harness-integrity check and they pass, ranking correctly by severity on all four targets.

Line 709-711 states the file 'has observed_time values that are all 2026 bulk scrapes, so the FILE cannot prove the box was observed before the cutoff'.
